name: Fun Drastic
package_note: Fun Drastic: a standalone themed frontend for the upstream drastic64 emulator, provided by an LD_PRELOAD hook. Ships its own SDL2 stack (Wayland video, evdev joystick, PulseAudio). Installs in the drastic slot (id=drastic). State lives in its own .umrk/mlp1/fundrastic directory and never touches any other package's state.
